This Lease Agreement made the 2025-07-07, by and between Stewart Abbott [name of lessor], of 2896 Ward Rapid [street address], State of California , hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and Schowalter, Beer and Zemlak [name of lessee], of 1230 Elda Divide [street address], State of , hereinafter California referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:
